defaults.first_message_template: desk {desk} on office {mill_office}. learn-label {lessons_label}. load only the mill-desk skill (not mill-build-assist). run `mill --office {mill_office} todo --mine` and do open work; do not read the mail backlog or scan the board. then sit: `mill --office {mill_office} connect-wait {desk}` in the FOREGROUND (never background, never &, never a separate mill connect). on a hint: read that letter first; work letter -> do it, reply, sit again; status note -> mark, sit again; stop letter -> stay down; dropped socket -> sit again. never two sits. human chat wins over mail. after crash/resume, read inbox before sitting. near {context_restart_tokens} tokens: write learn-{desk}, open work, and a handoff, then ask for a fresh desk-start (never resume, never compact).
